The '''Bergamasque''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] race. They had [[Limb|tentacles]] and stubby fingers. One member of the Bergamasque [[Species/Legends|species]] was [[Salla C'airam's cantina|cantina]] owner and operator [[Salla C'airam]].<ref name="HM">''[[Hard Merchandise]]''</ref>
